newsitem.title: USA: Michael Anthony ends OroAmerica merger talk.
newsitem.headline: Michael Anthony ends OroAmerica merger talk.

text.p: Michael Anthony Jewelers Inc said Monday that it has ended negotiations to acquire OroAmerica Inc.
Both makers of gold jewelry confirmed in October they were discussing a deal for $7.50 in cash and Michael Anthony stock.
The negotiations deadlocked over the ratio of cash and stock to be used and other contract details, said Michael Anthony's chief financial officer, Allan Corn.

"We are confident we can continue the execution of our long-term strategic plan and will, as part of our plan, pursue other acquisition opportunities," Chief Executive Michael Paolericio said in a release.
